P.name: Determination
P.title: Template:Data Xin Zhao/Determination
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Determination|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Xin Zhao
|skill        = I
|icon         = Determination.png
|icon2        = Xin Zhao Challenged Mark.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Xin Zhao's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ais|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' first slash hit and thrust on at least one enemy hit each generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Determination'', stacking up to 3 times. The third stack {{tt|consumes them|See notes for consumption details}} all to deal {{as|{{pp|15 to 60 for 4|key=%|1 to 16|formula=15% + 15% every 5 levels}} AD}} {{as|(+ {{pp|5 to 20 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heal}} '''Xin Zhao''' for {{as|{{pp|2 to 5|key=%|1;6;11}} of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{pp|40;50;70|1;6;11|key=%}} AP)}}.
|description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Challenge:}} ''{{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' and, if ''{{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}}'' has been learned, '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attacks and ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'', apply a {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} mark to certain enemies hit for 3 seconds. Only one enemy can be marked as {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} at a time; applying the mark to a new target removes it from the previous one. ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'' and ''{{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}}'' have interactions against {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} targets.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = proc
|parry        = unknown
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
;Determination Details
* The ''healing'' and '''bonus''' damage work on different stacking systems, each counting its stacks and being consumed separately. While both stack {{tip|on-hit}}, the '''bonus''' damage stacks are consumed {{tip|on-attack}}, and the healing ones {{tip|on-hit}}.
** The ''healing'' stacks are denoted in the buff-bar.
** If {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} were to trigger when the stacks are at maximum, they will grant the healing but not the '''bonus''' damage, thus causing an out-of-sync between the stacks shown in-game versus when the '''bonus''' damage is dealt.
* Only the initial slash of {{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}} can generate a ''Determination'' stack. Slashes after the first do not count for stack generation.
* The stack counter displays 1–3 rather than the usual 0–2, meaning that a count of 1 does not translate to having 1 stack.
* Stacks reset when '''Xin Zhao''' {{tip|death|dies}}.
* Stacks of ''Determination'' will be gained even if the attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Determination's'' interaction with ''parrying'' effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|blind}}).
* ''Determination'' deals {{tip|proc damage}}.
** Since it is a separate instance of damage when applied by basic attack or either of {{ais|W|Xin Zhao}} strikes, flat damage reduction that applies to both the main and bonus damage such as {{cais|Tantrum|Amumu}} passive will reduce each, for twice the reduction.
** The bonus damage cannot {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}}.
* When applied by a basic attack:
** The attack uses a unique animation.
** The bonus damage benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
*** {{pending for test}} It {{tip|applies life steal}} specifically.
** Neither the bonus damage or heal will be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* When applied by {{ai|W|Xin Zhao}}:
** Triggers against the closest target struck by the first slash/thrust (equals first target to receive spell effects).
** Does not benefit from {{sti|life steal}}, including not healing from ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' 33% conversion for this bonus damage.
** Since {{tip|proc damage}} is 'single target', {{tip|drain|Vamp}} will heal from 100% of the bonus damage.
** The bonus damage will be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}, the heal will not.
;Challenged Details
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the mark application from {{ai|W|Xin Zhao}}, but not from basic attacks and {{ai|E|Xin Zhao}}.
* 
<!--Blurb-->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Xin Zhao}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' strikes generate a stack of ''Determination'', stacking up to 3 times.
|blurb2       = Upon generating the final stack, '''Xin Zhao''' consumes them to {{tip|heal}} himself and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Innate:}} ''{{ais|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}}'' final thrust marks enemies as [[File:Xin Zhao Challenged Mark.png|24px|link=]]{{as|Challenged|buzzword}} for a few seconds. If {{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}} has been learned, '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attacks and {{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}} also apply the mark. His abilities have special interactions against [[File:Xin Zhao Challenged Mark.png|24px|link=]]{{as|Challenged|buzzword}} targets.
}}

Q.name: Three Talon Strike
Q.title: Template:Data Xin Zhao/Three Talon Strike
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Three Talon Strike|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Xin Zhao
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Three Talon Strike.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' empowers his next three {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} within 5 seconds to each have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and reduce his other {{tip|ability|abilities'}} {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} by 1 second. Each attack refreshes the duration.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|15 to 75}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 75*3}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = The third attack {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} the target for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
|description3 = ''Three Talon Strike's'' '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
|description4 = ''Three Talon Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|7 to 5}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 30
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time = none
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = spell
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = True
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the knock up.
* The enhanced attacks present input buffering during their wind-up animation ('''Xin Zhao''' cannot be issued any commands until after it ends).
* The attack counter displayed on '''Xin Zhao's''' status bar is incremented on-hit.{{bug}}
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Xin Zhao}} empowers his next few {{tip|basic attacks|attacks}} within a duration to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{sti|ah|reduce}} his other {{tip|ability}} cooldowns.
|blurb2      = The last empowered attack will also briefly {{tip|airborne|knock up}} the target.
}}

W.title: Template:Data Xin Zhao/Wind Becomes Lightning

E.name: Audacious Charge
E.title: Template:Data Xin Zhao/Audacious Charge
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Audacious Charge|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Xin Zhao
|skill        = E
|icon         = Audacious Charge.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} all targets hit by 30% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. ''Audacious Charge's'' range is increased against ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' targets.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
|description2 = '''Xin Zhao''' then gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|38 to 70}}% {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 5% '''bonus''' attack speed from non-buff sources)|as}}}}
|description3 = ''{{ai|Three Talon Strike|Xin Zhao}} and {{ai|Crescent Guard|Xin Zhao}} can be cast during the dash.''
|cooldown     = 11
|cost         = 60
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = none
|speed        = 2500
|target range = {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|650|Normal range}}|{{tt|1100|Enhanced range against Challenged targets}}}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|250|Damage radius}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|projectile   = 
|callforhelp  = True
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|notes        = 
* The primary target cannot dodge ''Audacious Charge's'' effects.
** The target will always emit the area of effect from their position.
* ''Audacious Charge'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 200 units.
<!--Blurb-->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Xin Zhao}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them. He then gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
|blurb2      = ''Audacious Charge's'' {{sti|range}} is increased against a [[File:Xin Zhao Challenged Mark.png|24px|link=]]{{as|Challenged|buzzword}} target.
}}

R.name: Crescent Guard
R.title: Template:Data Xin Zhao/Crescent Guard
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Crescent Guard|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Xin Zhao
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Xin Zhao's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'' apply the ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' mark to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit, with the latter applying the mark to the farthest champion hit in the area of effect or the primary target if they are a champion.
|icon2        = Crescent Guard.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' sweeps his spear around him, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, capped at 600 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, and {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} all targets hit that are not ''{{ai|Challenged|Xin Zhao|border=false}}'' up-to 700 units over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, as well as {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for the same duration. 
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|75 to 275}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}} {{as|(+ 15% of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
|description3 = For the next 4 seconds, '''Xin Zhao''' is {{tip|invulnerable}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} far away from him.
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|500|Knockback radius}}|{{tt|450|Immunity minimum radius}}}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|120 to 100}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = {{fd|0.35}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = False
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Pet|Pets}}, {{tip|stealthed trap|traps}}, {{tip|ground-targeted|ground}} {{tip|area of effect|AoEs}}, {{tip|damage over time|DoTs}}, and delayed-damage abilities (e.g. {{ai|Death Mark|Zed}}, {{ai|Explosive Charge|Tristana}}, {{ai|Hemoplague|Vladimir}}) will not damage '''Xin Zhao''' if the enemy champion source is outside the circle when the damage applies.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
<!--Blurb-->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive - Challenge:}} The last enemy champion hit by {{cis|Xin Zhao}} {{tip|basic attacks}} or ''{{ai|Audacious Charge|Xin Zhao}}'' is marked [[File:Xin Zhao Challenged Mark.png|24px|link=]]{{as|Challenged|buzzword}} for a short time.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Xin Zhao''' sweeps his spear to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies based on {{as|their '''current''' health}}, this will also briefly {{tip|airborne|knock back}} and {{tip|stun}} those not marked {{as|Challenged|buzzword}}.
|blurb3       = For the next few seconds, '''Xin Zhao''' is {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} far away from of him.
}}
